title: 2015 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement: On her first day of work, Janabel sold one widget. On day two, she sold three widgets. On day three, she sold five widgets, and on each succeeding day, she sold two more widgets than she had sold on the previous day. How many widgets in total had Janabel sold after working \(20\) days?

solutions.text:
We want to find \[1+3 + \cdots + 39.\] Pairing terms from the ends gives \[\begin{aligned} &(1+39)+(3+37)+\cdots\\ &\qquad +(19+21). \end{aligned}\] There are \(10\) pairs, and each pair sums to \(40.\) Therefore, the sum is \[10\cdot40=400.\]

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: The daily sales are the first \(20\) positive odd numbers.
Pair the first and last terms, second and next-to-last terms, and so on.
